report:
# INC-2101 · checkout
Severity: sev2
From 09:12 to 09:47 UTC, 18% of checkout requests failed with TLS errors.
Root cause: the TLS certificate on the checkout load balancer expired. The renewal job had been disabled in March.
Fix: renewed the certificate and turned the renewal job back on.

expected.root_cause: The TLS certificate on the checkout load balancer expired.

report:
# INC-2102 · payments
Severity: sev1
No card payments went through for 26 minutes during the evening peak.
A database migration took a lock on the transactions table and held it until the migration finished.
We stopped the migration, the lock was released and payments recovered at 19:58.

expected.root_cause: A database migration locked the transactions table.

report:
# INC-2103 · search
Severity: sev3
Search results were up to six hours stale on Tuesday morning. No errors were shown to customers.
The nightly index rebuild ran out of disk space and stopped halfway, so the old index stayed live.
Disk was expanded and the rebuild re-run.

expected.root_cause: The nightly index rebuild ran out of disk space.

report:
# INC-2104 · auth
Severity: sev1
Every user was logged out at 14:03 and nobody could log back in for 41 minutes.
Root cause: deploy 7.12 changed the key used to sign session tokens, so all existing tokens became invalid.
Rolled back to 7.11.

expected.root_cause: A deploy changed the key used to sign session tokens.

report:
# INC-2105 · notifications
Severity: sev3
Password reset emails were delayed by up to 40 minutes.
Our email provider rate-limited the sending account after a marketing campaign used the same account.
Marketing now sends from a separate account.

expected.root_cause: The email provider rate-limited the sending account after a marketing campaign used it.

report:
# INC-2106 · inventory
Declared sev1 at 08:20. Downgraded to sev2 at 08:35 once we saw that orders were still being accepted.
Stock counts were wrong on product pages for about an hour.
Root cause: after the Redis node restarted, thousands of requests rebuilt the same cache keys at once (a cache stampede) and the stock service timed out.

expected.root_cause: A cache stampede after the Redis node restarted.

report:
# INC-2107 · shipping
Severity: sev2
No shipping labels could be printed for 2 hours.
The carrier changed the response format of its label API without notice, and our parser rejected every response.
Patched the parser; asked the carrier for change notices.

expected.root_cause: The carrier changed the response format of its label API.

report:
# INC-2108 · profile
Severity: sev3
Profile pages were slow (p95 4s) for most of Thursday.
Cause: an image resize job for old avatars filled the shared worker queue, so profile requests waited behind it.
The resize job now runs on its own queue.

expected.root_cause: An image resize job filled the shared worker queue.

report:
# INC-2109 · checkout
Severity: sev2
Checkout was slow and 7% of orders timed out between 11:00 and 11:30.
Root cause: a config push set the database connection pool size for checkout to 5 instead of 50.
Reverted the config and added a check on pool size to the config linter.

expected.root_cause: A config push set the database connection pool size to 5.

report:
# INC-2110 · payments
Severity: sev2
Refund requests failed intermittently for 50 minutes.
A client with a misconfigured retry policy retried every failed call immediately, which doubled the request rate to the refunds API.
The client was fixed and rate limits were added per client.

expected.root_cause: A misconfigured client's retries doubled the request rate.

report:
# INC-2111 · search
Severity: sev2
Search nodes restarted every few hours over the weekend and queries failed while they did.
Root cause: a memory leak in the query parser introduced in version 3.4.
Rolled back to 3.3; the leak is fixed in 3.5.

expected.root_cause: A memory leak in the query parser in version 3.4.

report:
# INC-2112 · auth
Severity: sev3
About 2% of logins failed with "token expired" right after login.
Two hosts had clock skew of more than 5 minutes after an NTP outage, so fresh tokens looked expired.

expected.root_cause: Clock skew on two hosts made new tokens look expired.

report:
# INC-2113 · notifications
Severity: sev2
Push notifications were not delivered for 3 hours.
A DNS change pointed the push gateway at the old cluster, which had been shut down.
DNS was corrected.

expected.root_cause: A DNS change pointed the push gateway at the old, shut-down cluster.

report:
# INC-2114 · inventory
Severity: sev3
Some stock counts were doubled on Sunday morning.
The stock import cron job ran twice when the clocks changed for daylight saving time.
The job now runs in UTC.

expected.root_cause: A cron job ran twice when the clocks changed for daylight saving time.

report:
# INC-2115 · reported by the payments on-call
Severity: sev2
Checkout returned errors for 15% of carts for 20 minutes. Payments and auth were paged and confirmed they were healthy throughout.
The incident was in checkout: a feature flag sent all traffic to the new cart service before it had been scaled up.

expected.root_cause: A feature flag sent all traffic to the new cart service before it was scaled up.

report:
# INC-2116 · search, with inventory and profile on the call
Severity: sev2
Search returned empty results for a third of queries for 35 minutes.
Inventory's stock feed was 10 minutes late that morning, but that is normal and did not affect search.
Root cause: two search nodes were drained for maintenance and no replacements were added.

expected.root_cause: Two search nodes were drained for maintenance without replacements.

report:
# INC-2117 · shipping
Severity: sev2
Labels printed on Monday carried the wrong delivery date. Notifications then sent those wrong dates to customers by email, but the notifications service itself worked as designed.
Cause: a timezone bug in shipping's label generation.

expected.root_cause: A timezone bug in label generation.

report:
# INC-2118 · payments
Severity: sev1
Every payment was declined for 12 minutes. Checkout and auth showed errors too, but only because they wait on payments.
The API key for our fraud-check vendor had expired, so every fraud check failed and payments declined by default.

expected.root_cause: The fraud-check vendor's API key had expired.

report:
# INC-2119 · profile (avatar service involved)
Severity: sev3
Avatars were missing on profile pages for an hour.
A schema change in the profile database removed a column that the avatar service still read. The avatar service had no bug of its own.

expected.root_cause: A schema change removed a column the avatar service still read.

report:
# INC-2120 · auth
Severity: sev2
Login latency rose to 3 seconds for 25 minutes, then recovered by itself.
Root cause: still under investigation.

# INC-2121 · payments
Severity: sev1
Card payments failed for 9 minutes at 02:10. They recovered before anyone made a change.
We are still looking for the cause. We do not expect the certificate renewal planned for Friday to cause any problems.

# INC-2122 · checkout
Severity: sev3
Timeline:
- 16:02 error rate up to 4%
- 16:10 restarted the checkout pods
- 16:14 error rate back to normal
The cause has not been found yet.

# INC-2123 · search
Severity: sev2
Search was slow for 40 minutes. The cache layer is suspected, but this has not been confirmed.
A follow-up review is scheduled.

# INC-2124 · notifications
Severity: sev3
A queue backlog delayed SMS messages for 30 minutes, then cleared on its own.
The team will hold a review next week to find out why the backlog formed.
